updates.title: Test site sandbox
updates.text: The test site now works fully without a server and has a sandbox panel for coins, scores, bots and owner tools.

updates.title: Bots in every test mode
updates.text: On the test site, bots now race against you in Race and fight alongside you in Adventure, and owner log images work there too.

updates.title: Smarter test bots and cannon fix
updates.text: The cannon is now only in War maps, not in Hide and Seek. On the test site, bots run and jump like players, the sandbox menu is easier to use, you can create and switch between any number of accounts, and the owner's Admin Abuse and Edit buttons are back.

updates.title: TestPanel
updates.text: The test site's sandbox menu is now called TestPanel.

updates.title: Test site fixes
updates.text: On the test site, Log out works and the sign-in window lets you pick or create a test account, Story Mode links, skins and Home links work inside the site's folder, and broken avatar images are gone.

updates.title: No more climbing walls from the side
updates.text: You can no longer hang on a block's edge and climb it from the side: blocks are only reached by jumping on top. Bots that seek turn blue and caught bots turn orange, hiding bots spread out across the map, the leaderboard's Today and This Week numbers are correct, and only the owner sees the Admin Abuse button.

updates.title: Aiming in War and smarter bots
updates.text: In War you now aim slings, bombs and fireballs with the mouse, with a crosshair and a dotted flight path; on phones weapons aim at the nearest enemy by themselves. On the test site, bots now really play: in War they pick up tokens, buy weapons and medkits, keep their distance, aim at you, man the cannons and avoid poison, and with bots you also get Team, Control Points and Bro RED rounds. In Capture the Flag bots steal and defend flags, in Domination they take points, and the Hide and Seek seeker searches hiding spots instead of seeing through walls.

updates.title: Phone aiming and a new Pirate Bay
updates.text: On phones you can now aim in War: hold your finger on the map to see the flight path, and let go to throw or fire a cannon there. The War panel on phones moved to the top so it no longer covers your fighter. The Pirate Bay map was redrawn: real ship hulls, cannons standing on the decks, water that looks like water and a palm island in the middle.

updates.title: Private rooms, map search and player list
updates.text: You can now create a private room on any mode page and invite friends with a six-character code or a link; private rooms are not shown in the room list. Maps Browser can search maps by name and jump to any page, the first or the last. Press Tab in a game to see who is in the room: Mute hides a player's chat and Hide removes them from your screen, only for you.

updates.title: Stars, spikes, springs and emotions
updates.text: Map editor: new Star object, and a race map with stars only finishes once every star is collected; blocks can now look like spikes or a spring that throws you higher than a jump; a plus and minus button adds or removes copies of a block in a row. New race map Find all the stars. Buttons and levers turn blue when switched on and a used checkpoint flag turns grey. In a game you can sit down or lie down to sleep from the emotions button, and everyone sees it. Settings now let you pick how chat lines look above heads: outlined text, a box or a round bubble.

updates.title: New blocks: ice, keys, crumbling floors and more
updates.text: The map editor has new blocks and options: slippery ice, floors that crumble under your feet, platforms you can jump up through (hold Down to drop), blinking blocks, keys that open locked doors, buttons that stay pressed for a few seconds, and zones with low gravity or wind. Race maps can turn on double jump and fall damage. In Race, press R to go back to your checkpoint and hold Down to fall faster.

updates.title: Round banners, map skip and new settings
updates.text: Rounds now start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown and a Start!, Hide! or Seek! sign across the screen. In Race you can vote to skip the map: once more than half the room agrees, a new map starts. Race also shows how far along the map you are in percent. The player list has a Hide all button. Settings have a new Game section: a low-end PC mode without particles and screen shake, a colorblind mode that stripes poison blocks, and your own keys for left, right, jump and down.

updates.title: New shapes and editor tools
updates.text: The triangle in the map editor can now be a right triangle, rhombus, trapezoid, parallelogram, semicircle, pentagon, hexagon or star, and can be mirrored. Shapes can be see-through, have an outline of any thickness and color, or be invisible in the game while still blocking the way. Number fields accept simple math like 100+50. New editor buttons: jump to the start point, show what the player sees, and pick your own editor background color. The editor now warns you before you close a tab with unsaved changes.

updates.title: Levels, badges, records and the map of the day
updates.text: Profiles now show your level with an XP bar (XP comes from your Race and Hide and Seek scores), a star for every 50 maps finished, and badges like Veteran, Map creator, Racer, Hunter and Survivor. You can gift coins to other players from their profile, and redeem promo codes in Settings. Every map shows how many times it was played and its record; race maps keep a top 10 of best times, and you get a message when you make it in. Maps Browser can sort by most played and hot this week, and has a Map of the day: finish it for bonus coins and keep a daily streak.

updates.title: Weather, night and effect triggers
updates.text: Maps can now have an atmosphere: rain, snow, night (only the area around you is lit) or fog. The editor has a new Effect trigger zone: walking into it shakes the screen, flashes it white or shows a message. Any block or text can be a parallax background that slowly follows the camera. Landing from a big jump kicks up a little dust.

updates.title: Accessories shop
updates.text: The Avatar page has a new Accessories shop: hats (party hat, cap, beanie, top hat, crown), capes and wings, sparkle, fire and rainbow trails, a pet slime, cat or dog that follows you, confetti or ghost death effects and a rainbow glow. Buy with coins, wear or take off any time; everyone in the game sees what you wear.

updates.title: Follow authors, report maps and more
updates.text: You can follow a player from their profile: their new maps show up in your notifications, just like your friends' maps. Maps Browser has a Report link to tell the owner about a broken or bad map. The friend requests tab has an Accept all button, friends are marked in the in-game player list, and the home page shows the hottest maps of the week.

updates.title: Smarter map logic
updates.text: New editor logic for map makers: blocks that appear when a button or lever is turned on, effect triggers that toggle targets like a lever or open a random one, rotating and pulsing blocks that only move while their button is held, buttons that need several players standing on them, and blocks that chase the player within a set radius. Race maps can turn on sprint: hold Shift to run faster.

updates.title: Hide and Seek: role wish, give up, free camera
updates.text: In Hide and Seek there is a new menu button at the top. Choose whether you'd rather hide or seek next round, and the roulette will lean your way. Hiders can give up and leave the round. Once you're caught, you can turn on a free camera and look around the map with the arrow keys.

updates.title: Ghost runs and editor helpers
updates.text: In Race, a see-through ghost now runs your best path on maps you've already finished, so you can race yourself (you can turn it off in Settings). In the editor you can cut a block in half, put your own picture under the map to trace over, and let other players copy your map: such maps get a Copy to editor link in Maps Browser.

updates.title: New modes: duel, auto-run and Hot Trap
updates.text: Race has a new 1v1 duel button: you are matched with one opponent, every round is won by whoever finishes first, and the duel score keeps adding up while you both stay. Race maps can turn on auto-run: your character runs by itself and you only jump (hold Left to slow down). Hide and Seek has a new Hot Trap round: a shorter round where the seeker must catch at least a third of the hiders, or the seeker burns and the hiders win.

updates.title: Soccer in Team Battle
updates.text: Team Battle has a new Soccer round for two teams: touch the ball to kick it, and score in the other team's goal (their base, now drawn as a net). The first team to 3 goals wins, and the score is shown at the top. The Hide and Seek menu with Give up no longer shows up in team modes.

updates.title: Ziplines and map search in your profile
updates.text: The map editor has a new Zipline: jump up to the rope to grab it and slide down, picking up speed, and jump again to let go. Your profile's Maps tab now has a search box to find your own maps by name.

updates.title: Grappling hook
updates.text: Race maps can turn on a grappling hook: press E to hook onto a block ahead and above you and swing on the rope across gaps. Jump or press E again to let go.

updates.title: Draw your own shapes
updates.text: The map editor has a new Polygon tool: click to place corners, then press Enter, double-click or click the first corner to finish. You can stand on these shapes in the game like on any block. On small screens the editor's top bar no longer hides under the mode tabs.

updates.title: Textures and a brush in the editor
updates.text: Blocks, circles and triangles can now use a texture instead of a plain color: brick, wood, grass, stone, metal or sand. A new Brush tool paints the map with small blocks on a grid, using the last color and texture you picked.

updates.title: Crouching
updates.text: Hold Down while standing to crouch: you get shorter, move at half speed and can squeeze under low blocks. You stand up again when you let go and there is room above your head.

updates.title: Rescue helicopter in zombie rounds
updates.text: Zombie maps can now have a rescue helicopter. In a zombie round, a hider who reaches it is rescued and flies away: the zombies can no longer catch them, and they count as survivors at the end of the round.

updates.title: More map tools: crush, checkpoint lives, morphing
updates.text: Moving blocks can now crush you. Checkpoints can have a number of lives: lose them all and you start over. New effect triggers recolor blocks or toggle targets whenever the player dies, and blocks can smoothly grow or shrink with a lever. New sand floor slows you down, blocks can have rounded corners, there are quarter-circle and cloud shapes, and levers move smoothly. Race maps can set a 1 or 3 minute time, choose their own background color, use night by the real clock, and show an arrow pointing to the finish when it is off screen.

updates.title: Profiles, hall of fame and a lobby chat
updates.text: Profiles now have reputation, a short status and a link. The leaderboard has a Hall of Fame. The home page has a shared chat for signed-in players. The shop sells gold and glowing nicknames. The players list shows recent chat, and settings list the players you muted or hid.

updates.title: Map categories, promotion and a weekly map pack
updates.text: Authors can set a category for their maps and filter the Maps Browser by it. A new Shuffle sort shows maps in random order. Authors can promote a map for 50 coins to show it first among the newest maps for a day. Map authors get a coin for each new like. Every week there is a pack of 5 race maps with a coin reward for finishing all of them.

updates.title: Ninja rounds, team choice and bear traps
updates.text: Hide and Seek has a new Ninja round where you only see players close to you. In Team Battle you can switch to a team with fewer players before the round starts. Hiders can buy a bear trap in the shop that stops a seeker for 3 seconds. In Race, the next map gets easier or harder depending on how many players finished the last one. Wind zones in the editor can switch direction on a timer.
